environment.note: wave-07 B9 unified admission: actual_native + package-local

cases.title: admission evaluates all gates in one call
detail: all 6 gates evaluated without short-circuit; unmet=budget_reservation,cost_bound

cases.title: execution identity is observed, not defaulted
the verdict carries an identity digest that changes with identity
detail: verdict is bound to an identity digest; a different model yields a different digest

cases.title: session facts come from a real server
the fresh arm and the author arm use different session kinds
detail: ephemeral fresh thread and a turn-backed persistent author checkpoint are distinct paths; a goal budget cannot attach to the fresh arm

cases.title: the production builder copies bytes and shares no inode
detail: 1 file(s) copied; no Git surface; no shared inode

cases.title: a link-based copy request is refused at admission
detail: every known-unsafe mode is refused with the sealed-copy rationale; an unknown mode is also refused; "bytes" is accepted

cases.title: admission itself refuses a link copyMode, not just the helper
detail: admission refused the hardlink copyMode and reported the sealed-copy requirement

evidence.gap: refusing copyMode "hardlink": a sealed copy must copy bytes and share no inode with the author tree

cases.title: a deliberately unsafe link builder CAN corrupt the author tree
detail: the unsafe builder does share an inode, so refusing it is a real control and not a tautology

cases.title: host isolation is a real enforcement mechanism, not a claim
detail: host isolation via macos-seatbelt: network denied, author home unreadable, capsule scratch allowed

cases.title: the budget gate refuses an UNKNOWN ledger remainder
detail: a reconstructed ledger with UNKNOWN remainder does not admit a run; the empty ledger is not 4 free slots

evidence.reason: grant wave03-b-native is UNVERIFIED: the ledger was reconstructed from product records and its remainder is UN

cases.title: a missing reservation hook is its own gap
detail: admission reports the missing hook as its own reason instead of a generic refusal

evidence.gap: no reservation hook: a billable run must reserve before send

cases.title: the cost gate is blocked independently of the ledger
detail: cost bound is blocked on its own 9 reasons; a valid reservation would not unlock it

evidence.first: price basis incomplete: no authoritative price source, no concrete model id, no observed-a

cases.title: a refused verdict exposes no launch plan
detail: REFUSED carries launch=null, so a consumer cannot start a run from it

cases.title: admission states what it does not claim
detail: admission explicitly disclaims 4 things, including turn success and product acceptance

notClaimed: that a real vendor turn will succeed
that a real turn is bounded (cost_bound reports the measured runtime, which is BLOCKED)
that admission is product or release acceptance

cases.title: the author tree is unchanged by admission and capsule work
detail: author working file is byte-identical and its credential file still exists untouched
